Playwright 1.51.1 records request `Cookie` headers and parsed cookies in full mode (`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\node_modules\.pnpm\playwright-core@1.51.1\node_modules\playwright-core\lib\server\har\harTracer.js:51-58,215-221`). The Host accepts the cookie as a bearer credential for the running process (`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-web\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\web\LocalHostServer.java:69,204-214,829-839`). However, `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\scripts\run-stage4-host-restart.mjs:80-85,188-195,221-230` scans the HAR and database only for the unrelated launch-token bytes, so it reports clean even though the HAR persisted the still-reusable session cookie before Host shutdown. No files were edited and no secret values were exposed.
